title: The Button Sovereignty
location: The Exchange Concourse, the Button Court's public territory beyond the Grate
notes: Per-line script for Act 2. Same format as script/ACT_01_SCRIPT.json: line_id, speaker, text, context. Not yet voiced or produced -- this is a script/design pass only, matching the state Act 1 was in before its audio pass. See docs/ACT_02_DESIGN.md for the hotspot/item/topic/event structure, docs/STORY_ARC.md for how this act's plot ties to Act 1's planted hooks and pays forward into Act 3, and docs/ANIMATION_BIBLE.md for the animation rules governing each beat's performance.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 0, Cold open, transition in from Act 1
lines.text: Okay. Bigger room. Much bigger room. Somebody in here really likes stamps.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Sign-in log said something round and shiny came through here. That's my marble talking. Or about my marble. You know what I mean.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A little window, a little sign: 'ALL BUTTONS WEIGHED AND VERIFIED. NO EXCEPTIONS. NO, NOT EVEN THAT ONE.'

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Currency Exchange Window / use, permanent flavor fail
lines.text: I don't have anything to exchange. Also I don't think I want whatever the exchange rate on a shoelace tip is.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A notice board. Mostly button-related bulletins. One is just the word 'AUDIT' underlined four times.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Public Notice Board / flavor rotate 1
lines.text: 'Lost: one (1) sense of proportion. Reward: modest.'

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Public Notice Board / flavor rotate 2 (red herring seed)
lines.text: This one's just gossip, really: 'Old Bottlecap knows more than he's letting on.' No signature. Bold accusation from an unsigned note.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Public Notice Board / flavor rotate 3
lines.text: 'Reminder: the Sovereignty does not confirm or deny the existence of an Annex.' ...that phrasing is doing a lot of work.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A citizen, filing a formal dispute about a button that is, and I quote, 'definitely two shades lighter than the button it was sold to me as.'

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Citizen Filing Booth / flavor rotate
lines.text: The clerk has stamped the complaint 'VALID, BUT WHY.' Fair, honestly.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A spool of thread, half unraveled. Somebody was in a hurry, or somebody has a cat.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Grabbed it. Never know when a good length of thread is exactly what a situation needs.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A needle, stuck point-first in a floorboard crack like a tiny sword in a tiny stone.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Pulled it free. No prophecy triggered. Slightly disappointed.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Combine needle + thread -> item: threaded-needle
lines.text: Threaded needle. Not glamorous, but somewhere out there something is about to stop falling apart.

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.context: Sec 2, Scuttle reconnect, auto-fire on approach
lines.text: 'Scuse, delivery, no time— oh. Oh, it's you. From the cobweb. You're slower than you looked.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: You're the one who almost ran me over. I have questions.

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.text: No time for questions! Got a route! Got a schedule! Got a very specific number of stops between now and lunch!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: One question. Sixty seconds. I'll even walk with you.

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.text: Fine! Walking counts as working. Go.

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.text: Courier, three routes a day, never missed a delivery, never read one either. Not my job to read them. My job is fast.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: You've never once looked at what you're carrying?

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.text: Looking's slow. I don't do slow. Ask literally anyone.

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.text: Mostly I run Court intake to the Annex. 'Round Asset,' 'Unclaimed Property,' whatever the label says, I don't argue with labels.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: What's a 'round asset,' exactly?

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.text: Honestly? No idea. Round, I guess. I deliver the box, not the box's feelings.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 2, Use threaded-needle near Scuttle (wrong target, comedic), or ambient beat before parcel drop
lines.text: Careful, you're about to—

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.context: Sec 2, Scuttle fumbles a parcel, event: parcel-dropped, addItem: intake-parcel
lines.text: —dropped a parcel! No, don't tell dispatch, I'll circle back, I always circle back—

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Little parcel, little label: 'ROUND ASSET INTAKE — c/o Chairman Toggle, The Annex.' Huh. Huh huh huh.

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.context: Sec 2, Scuttle exits scene after parcel beat, non-interactive from here
lines.text: Route's already blown, might as well finish it fast. Catch you around, slow one!

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.context: Sec 3, Bramble check-in, auto-fire once parcel obtained
lines.text: You found a — is that a Court intake parcel? Where did you even— you know what, I don't want to know.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 3, Pip shows parcel to Bramble
lines.text: It says 'round asset.' Round. Shiny. Sound familiar?

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: I— there's a process for everything, that doesn't mean I— look, the cubby wall is real! Everything on the cubby wall is real and properly filed!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: I'm not saying it isn't. I'm asking about the stuff that's NOT on the cubby wall.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: ...There's an Annex. I've never been inside it. I tell myself that's not the same as knowing what's inside it. I'm starting to think it is the same.

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 4, Grommet threshold, first encounter, auto-fire on approach
lines.text: ...oh. Hi. You're new. New ones usually go the other way.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: I'm looking for something that might be past you. No offense, but you're kind of enormous.

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.text: I get that a lot. I'm not trying to be enormous. I'm just standing where I was told to stand.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Who told you to?

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 4, Grommet doesn't fully know, close of first exchange
lines.text: ...huh. That's a good question. I don't actually remember. I've just always stood here.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 4, Examine Grommet, notices frayed seam
lines.text: There's a seam on his shoulder coming loose. Whole thread's just... hanging there. Has to bother him.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 4, Use threaded-needle on Grommet, puzzle success
lines.text: Hold still a second — just this one bit, right here—

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 4, Grommet reaction to mending, event: grommet-trust-earned
lines.text: ...oh. Oh, that's — nobody's ever just fixed a part of me before. They usually just point at the door part.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: It's a loose thread, not a big deal. You looked uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.text: Nobody noticed before. You noticed. I think I'd like to help you, actually, if that's allowed.

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 4, Topic: about the Annex (unlocked post-trust)
lines.text: It's dark in there. Full of shiny stacked-up things, floor to who-knows. I water it sometimes. I don't know why I water it. I don't think that helps.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Could you just... let me in?

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 4, Grommet holds, sets up Act 3
lines.text: I want to. I do. But it's the one thing I've always done, and I need a minute before I stop doing it forever. Ask the Chairman first. Do it the — the polite way. I'll be right here.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1 (late), Founder's Ledger prop / examine, tucked near the Notice Board
lines.text: An old, old ledger. Water-stained. First entry, in handwriting nothing else here matches: 'Standard set this day, one button to one button, fair and plain. — O.B.'

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: O.B. ...Old Bottlecap. He didn't just guard a gate. He started all of this.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: He set the button standard? Himself? Why would he just — sit at a gate for years and never say —

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: I don't think he sat down. I think somebody sat him down. There's a difference, and I don't love what it implies about who's running things now.

lines.speaker: CHAIRMAN_TOGGLE
lines.context: Sec 6, Chairman Toggle audience chamber, auto-fire on approach
lines.text: A petitioner! Wonderful, wonderful, I do so love a petitioner. State your grievance, in triplicate if possible.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: You've got my marble. In the Annex. I have a delivery label that says so.

lines.speaker: CHAIRMAN_TOGGLE
lines.text: 'Unclaimed round asset,' the label says, and unclaimed property is unclaimed property — that is the ENTIRE point of having a filing system, you understand. Chaos otherwise. Total chaos.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: It's not unclaimed if he's standing right here claiming it. That's — that's the literal definition of claimed.

lines.speaker: CHAIRMAN_TOGGLE
lines.text: Fascinating jurisprudence, Ms. Bramble, truly, but the Annex is not open to the public, was never open to the public, and will not be open to the public today. Good AFTERNOON.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 7, Fallback / use item on scenery
lines.text: Doesn't seem like it's supposed to go there. I'll hang onto it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Still small. Still determined. Getting a little better at both.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 7, First distant tremor, foreshadowing Act 3
lines.text: ...did the floor just do that? That was not a floor thing that floors normally do.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: That's early. That's — that's much earlier than the Roar usually— we don't have as much time as I thought we had.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Then Grommet doesn't get his minute. Sorry, big guy. Time to find out what's actually in that room.
